items.title: The Godfather
items.line: Opened in the US on 24 March 1972 after a New York premiere on the 14th. It cost $6 to 7 million and won three Oscars, including Best Picture.

items.title: The Watergate break-in
items.line: Burglars were caught in the Democratic National Committee offices at the Watergate on 17 June 1972. Sixty-nine people were eventually charged.

items.title: Fischer v Spassky
items.line: Bobby Fischer beat Boris Spassky 12½ to 8½ in Reykjavík between July and September 1972, after forfeiting game 2 in a row over the cameras.

items.title: Mark Spitz in Munich
items.line: Spitz won seven golds at the 1972 Munich Olympics and set a world record in every one of the seven events.

items.title: Pong
items.line: Atari's prototype went into Andy Capp's Tavern in August 1972 and the arcade game was announced on 29 November. By the end of 1974 Atari had sold more than 8,000.

items.title: M*A*S*H
items.line: Premiered on CBS on 17 September 1972 and ran 11 seasons and 256 episodes, finishing in February 1983.
